name: Sujata Parashar

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sujata Parashar is a novelist, poet and psychosocial trainer whose writing extends from fiction to accounts of everyday resilience. Her books include the Pursuit novels, the “Poetry Out and Loud” series and “Going Solo”, which brings together experiences of single parents. In an interview about that project, she connects her writing with work on emotional expression through Talk It Out Express.

Her paired poems here find possibility in modest acts of attention. “Paper Flowers” moves from isolation indoors to a terrace garden, where colour and sunlight interrupt the expectation of winter. “Scrambled Eggs” watches a mother at the stove and turns the preparation of a meal into an image of resourcefulness. Together they suggest how ordinary surroundings can offer both comfort and a way to begin again.
